notes: The What's Changed box now actually shows on the confirmation you look at. 1.24.2 put it on the plain-text version only: the designed email that you copy and send was still deciding on its own that a confirmation never carries the box, so it never appeared and the release looked like it had done nothing. Both versions now follow whatever the email has actually turned out to be, so the amber box sits above the You're locked in for card, exactly where it does on the quote. Nothing else changes: a first confirmation, or one with nothing changed since it was sent, stays plain, and sending resets the baseline.
